name: Sailships & Props Library
summary: Two historic sailing ships plus a shipwreck, rowboat and small props, with a demo mission.
description: High-poly PBR sailships (furled and hoisted sails), shipwreck, rowboat, crates, barrel and treasure chest, placed as vessels and structures. Extract directly into `Saved Games\DCS` ("extract here"). Works on any map; DCS 2.9.
